svg.text: Extreme Cases: Fibonacci Spiral Forces d = 1; Zero Width Preserves Div(a)
Comparing Gcd(13, 8) = {1} (coprime: only 1×1 tiles fit) and Gcd(21, 0) = {21} (degenerate 0-width rectangle)
Step-by-Step Invariant across all 5 Fibonacci Cuts:
Result: Gcd(13, 8) = { g | Div(g) = {1} } = { 1 } (only unit square tiles both)
Case 2: Zero Side Length (a = 21, b = 0 → g = 21)
Why Div(0) = ℕ in the type definition: every d tiles 0 (0 = 0 × d)!
Geometric meaning of d ∣ 0 (for every d ∈ ℕ):
• Zero copies of a d×d square cover height 0: 0 = 0 · d.
• So b = 0 imposes NO restriction on d: Div(0) = ℕ = {1, 2, 3, …}.
• Intersecting with Div(0) is identity: Div(a) ∩ Div(0) = Div(a).
Corner Case: Gcd(0, 0) = { g | Div(g) = Div(0) ∩ Div(0) = ℕ } = { 0 }
• Every d ∈ ℕ tiles a 0×0 point (0 = 0·d). Only g = 0 has Div(g) = ℕ.
• Div(a) ∩ Div(b) makes gcd(21,0) = 21 and gcd(0,0) = 0 automatic!
